latest.notes:
Adds Play Info to the log screens.

• Right-click any music row in the On Air log or the Logs screen and choose Play Info to see that song's Scheduled Ahead and Past Airings — the same information as the Song Airplay report, without leaving the log and typing the title back in.
• Rows with no song behind them — voice tracks, stop markers, external audio by name — don't offer it.

Includes everything in v0.5.76: the Song Airplay report listing real airings only, and the top-of-hour filler no longer favouring one record.
